description: Fetch a LabelGrid reference dataset used to resolve the IDs and codes the catalog and release tools expect. Pick ONE dataset with `type`: `genres` and `genre_categories` (genre IDs), `languages` (audio/metadata language codes), `contributor_roles`, `instruments`, `distro_outlets` (the outlets/stores available to you), `territories` (country codes), `issue_definitions` (review issue codes — string slugs — with severity and whether they block distribution), or `webhook_event_types` (event types with their payload schemas). Also exposed as MCP resources at labelgrid://reference/{type}; this tool is the fallback.
name: list_reference_data
title: List reference data
